title.en: Without the box: K and S

t.zh: 这个专题拿走框，只剩套用和证出的 K、S。早期的证明器就是这样：一条规则，其余的出发点都是<wiki-ref to="axiom"></wiki-ref>。这样的证明器叫<wiki-ref to="hilbert"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: This topic takes the box away, leaving Apply and the K and S you proved. Early provers were like this: one rule, and every other starting point an <wiki-ref to="axiom"></wiki-ref>. Such a prover is a <wiki-ref to="hilbert"></wiki-ref>.

step.en: Under a condition without a box

hint.zh: 在条件下套用，是 S 的事。
hint.en: Apply under a condition is what S does.

hint.zh: S 的三句不一定都是一个词。
hint.en: S’s three sentences need not each be a single word.
